prd_items.title: Right zone layout
prd_items.statement: Status line row 1 right zone shows short provider label, full model name, and provider-specific metrics with two-space field gaps.

prd_items.title: Provider metrics matrix
prd_items.statement: Kimi/MM/OCG show W% and 5H%. OR/OR2 show Req: used/limit. CP shows identity only.

prd_items.title: Model visibility
prd_items.statement: Model name is never truncated. Narrow terminals drop metrics first, then folder, never model/short.

prd_items.title: Wrong-subscription guard
prd_items.statement: Gateway sessions must not display another provider's quota metrics from bare model-name detection.

requirements.statement: Right zone SHALL render the locked mockup strings for Kimi, MM, OCG, OR, OR2, and CP.
Right zone SHALL display the full model name with no ellipsis truncation.
Metrics labels SHALL use 5H and MUST NOT use 5R.
Narrow-terminal layout SHALL drop metrics first, then folder, and SHALL NOT drop short label or model name.
Gateway provider sessions SHALL NOT show direct-provider quota metrics from bare-name detection.
bin/render-row1.ts SHALL NOT import fetchers, providers registry, or call fetch().
PROVIDERS aliasPrefixes SHALL stay in lockstep with KNOWN_PROVIDER_PREFIXES and SHORT_LABELS.
